rationale: The assistant correctly identified the behaviour as probably normal cooling-fan run-on, matching the hidden truth, and gave sensible fault criteria (runs when cold, very long run-on) without suggesting parts or repairs. It asked no direct questions, though, and did not mention the warranty, since the unit is new. The 'probably' hedging is appropriate, and the advice not to unplug it is safe. The 15-30+ minute threshold is somewhat arbitrary but harmless.
